# `button[dsDefinitionTerm]` — `DefinitionTermComponent`

Group: Overlay

A term inside running text or a label that carries its definition: `<button type="button" dsDefinitionTerm="Left the journey before the goal step.">exited</button>`. The button looks like the surrounding text with a dotted underline in `--text-tertiary`, takes the focus ring, and shows the definition in a tooltip on hover and focus; a click pins it until a click outside, `Escape` or blur. `[pinOnClick]="false"` where the click already acts, such as a sort button. Also takes `dsTooltipPlacement` and `dsTooltipClippedLead`.

<!-- inputs:button[dsDefinitionTerm] -->
All inputs: `pinOnClick: boolean = true`, `dsDefinitionTerm: string = ''`, `dsTooltipPlacement: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right' = 'top'`, `dsTooltipClippedLead: string = ''`
<!-- /inputs -->
